fusions.name: Hopping Edge
fusions.desc: A swing that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Plunging Leap
fusions.desc: A leaping blow that deals 15 damage, up to 2 times that at the maximum range of 8 tiles. You rush up to 7 tiles to the target first.

fusions.name: Twitch Tempo
fusions.desc: Your attack speed rises by 30% for 10 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Long Drop Chop
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 4 seconds.
